description: This file defines the IGrainTimer interface within the Orleans.Runtime namespace, representing a timer associated with a grain. It includes a method to change the timer's start time and interval, with detailed documentation on parameters and exceptions.

classes.name: IGrainTimer
classes.description: An interface representing a timer belonging to a grain, capable of being disposed and allowing modification of its timing parameters.

methods.name: Change
methods.description: Modifies the start time and interval of the timer using TimeSpan values, with detailed parameter and exception documentation.
